episode_row: MDP saver input from an unsound model-saver proxy / ledger inference

commits.subject: feat(saver): infer the 10-15 saver from best_streak + the per-round ledger; retire the model-saver proxy
commits.body:
load_decision_streak_state now infers the one-time, SEASON-SCOPED 10-15 saver instead of the
Phase-1 "model-saver when contest & model streak agree" proxy. When contest.saver_available is
None it calls infer_saver(parse_latest_ledger(...), contest.best_streak), which checks in order:
- a STABLE settled not_hit at pre-streak 10-15 that did not reset to 0 -> 'consumed'. Checked
  FIRST so ledger evidence of a consumption overrides the best_streak shortcut below.
- best_streak < 10 -> 'available': the account never reached the 10-15 zone this season, so the
  saver was never consumable. best_streak (seasonBestStreak) is a reliable counter immune to
  ledger windowing -- the only sound positive signal in 2c.
- otherwise (reached the zone, no confirmed consumption) -> 'unknown' -> conservatively
  unavailable: confirming the season saver survived needs complete coverage (Phase 2b).
contest_saver = (inference == "available"); a known contest saver is still authoritative.

The ledger parser (Task 2) underpins the 'consumed' detection and is the foundation for 2b.
Codex plan-review adjustments: #1 no ledger / no signal -> unknown -> unavailable (the proxy is
gone, so model saver=True never makes the contest saver True without evidence); #2 a consuming
round must be STABLE (two-read) and non-DD.

Three Codex 2c review rounds drove this. (1) An earlier "available from the latest snapshot"
inference was unsound under ledger windowing. (2) A coverage guard (require a visible reset) was
insufficient because the saver is SEASON-scoped (picks._apply_streak_day: a later reset does NOT
restore it) and the predictions array has no contiguity guarantee -- so the design moved to the
windowing-immune best_streak < 10 gate. (3) best_streak < 10 blindly trusted best_streak, an
unsafe false-available if it under-reports a since-reset peak (wrong manual override, or a stale
seasonBestStreak); fixed by checking a stable ledger consumption FIRST, so visible evidence wins
and the error direction is conservative. Verified on the live box: best_streak=9 (max historical
streak 9) -> saver available, sound. Residual (surfaced, not fixed here): a manual override that
under-reports best_streak AND a windowed ledger with no consuming row could still false-available;
manual overrides should set saver_available explicitly or enter best_streak correctly.

Tests rewritten off best_streak + ledger fixtures; boundary (best_streak==10, pre-streak 10/15/16
edges) and consumed-overrides-low-best_streak safety cases added; two contest_state saver tests
repointed. 127 passed across contest-state / ledger / saver / web / cli / orchestrator / health.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
